proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11500 vātālī explicitly supplies Old Awadhi bayāri and Awadhi bayār wind. Selected bayar/byar/beyar responses match that extended wind family, with vowel contraction and y/h alternation in the eastern forms qualified. The entry discusses and rejects an alternative vārdala explanation; this link follows its vātālī analysis. Local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: bjaɾ.
